summary.en: What a measuring tool printed, on the bench beside its output: the tool’s label, status · item · value lines, the result line in bold, room for a two-phrase claim.
summary.zh: 测量工具打印出的内容，放在输出旁的台面上：工具标签、状态 · 项目 · 数值各一行、加粗的结论行，上方留出两段主张的位置。

fits: A command’s report next to the output it describes.
notFor: A report typed for the film; more than five lines.

intent.en: The proof is the tool’s own output, read beside the thing it measured.
intent.zh: 证据是工具自己的输出，挨着被测的东西读。

content.en: A label, 1–5 lines of [status, item, value] (≤ 30 characters), a result line; a claim of 1–2 phrases (≤ 2 words).
content.zh: 一个标签、1–5 行 [状态, 项目, 数值]（≤ 30 字符）、一行结论；1–2 段主张（每段 ≤ 7 字）。

fits.zh: 命令的报告放在它描述的输出旁边。

notFor.zh: 为片子编的报告；多于五行。

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
